# BILLSzuka — Audit Log

## 2026-08-26 — master.csv production-readiness review

### Scope
Full data-integrity pass over `data/master.csv` (377 rows) and its 24 source
catalogs (`data/{Kraj}/catalog-[AB]-*.csv`), requested ahead of a production
release. Validated with `tools/validate_columns.py` + a custom cross-field
consistency pass (duplicate/malformed IDs, FROZEN-requirement compliance,
`rynek_skala` formula compliance, email/URL/VAT shape checks, encoding).

### Bugs found & fixed (source catalogs edited, then `master.csv` regenerated
via `verify_run.regenerate_master()` — 377 rows in, 377 rows out, no data loss)

1. **`rynek_skala` formula violation — 181/377 rows (48%)**. Column is
   documented (methodology.md §10) as auto-derived from `kraj`
   (`duży`=PL/CZ/FR, `średni`=RO/BG/HR/SI/SK/RS, `mały`=LT/LV/EE/MD), and
   `tools/config.rynek_skala_for()` is used by the row-insertion pipelines —
   but roughly half the existing rows had a stale/manually-diverged value.
   Backfilled all 181 rows to match the documented formula, across all 23
   catalogs that had drift (every country except Serbia's A-file).
2. **`PL-B-086`** (EDDcom Edyta Świetlik) was flagged `✅ FROZEN` while
   missing `adres` — violates the FROZEN requirements in
   `skills/verify-data/SKILL.md` ("Automatycznie DO-WERYFIKACJI: ... Puste
   kluczowe pola: adres"). Downgraded to `⚠️ DO-WERYFIKACJI (brak adresu)`.
3. **ID collision / schema violation**: `PL-X-051`, `PL-X-052`, `PL-X-053`
   (`catalog-B-PL.csv`) and `FR-X-001` (`catalog-B-FR.csv`) used a
   non-canonical "X" catalog-type letter — schema requires `{KOD}-{A|B}-{NNN}`
   — and collided numerically with `data/Polska/extra-leads-PL.csv`, which
   independently owns `PL-X-001..080` for three *entirely different*
   companies (Teks S.A. / Sieć DEF Hurtownie / Tyton-Hurt.pl vs. the
   PowerMatic-reseller leads Armorica / Prodap.pl / Shishka79.pl actually
   stored under those IDs in the catalog). Not yet an active collision
   (`extra-leads-*.csv` isn't compiled into master.csv today), but a landmine
   for whenever that staging file gets promoted. Renumbered to the next free
   B-sequence slot in each country: `PL-B-127/128/129`, `FR-B-013`.

Validated: full pytest suite (346 tests) still green; row/column counts
unchanged in every touched file; re-ran the consistency pass — all three
issue categories now at 0.

### Follow-up pass (same day) — RS/MD formatting cleanup

Re-inspected each flagged row's full context (`adres`, `telefon`, `rejestr_id`,
`notatki`, `zrodlo_danych`) before touching anything, to avoid destroying
research notes while normalizing format:

- **`nip_vat` (18 RS rows)**: stripped redundant `(PIB)` / `(PIB — <address>)`
  / `| MB <n>` annotations — verified each was already fully duplicated in
  `rejestr_id` (or, for the address case on `RS-B-002`, in `adres`) before
  stripping, so no info was lost. The 8 rows with the literal placeholder
  `"RS PIB do potwierdzenia"` (unconfirmed) were normalized to the project's
  standard `brak` placeholder.
- **`nip_vat` (7 MD rows)**: prefixed with `MD` (e.g. `1014600025721` →
  `MD1014600025721`) for `{CC}{digits}` consistency with every other
  country. Moldova's IDNO already fully duplicated in `rejestr_id`, so this
  is a pure formatting change, not new data.
- **`email` (4 RS rows)**: stripped the `" (do potwierdzenia)"` suffix now
  that the field is a clean, clickable address (e.g.
  `tamaris.co.rs/info@tamaris.co.rs`).
- **`RS-A-004` — real bug**: `email` field contained a *phone number*
  (`"+381 66 55-00-557 (WhatsApp / Viber)"`) while `telefon` was empty.
  Moved the value to `telefon`; `email` set to `brak`.
- **`RS-B-006`**: `email` = `"inhalika@info (do potwierdzenia)"` isn't a
  resolvable address (no TLD) and no source confirms a real one — rather
  than fabricate a guess, set `email` to `brak` and preserved the original
  string as a breadcrumb in `notatki` (`❓ niepotwierdzony e-mail...`).
- **`LT-B-010.email_decydent`** = `"brak publicznie (info@shamanas.lt jeśli
  aktywne)"` → normalized to `brak`, with the parenthetical hint preserved
  in `notatki`.
- **`RS-B-009.www`** = `"brak publicznej WWW"` → normalized to `brak`.

Validated: row/column counts unchanged in every touched file, full pytest
suite (346 tests) still green, `regenerate_master()` → 377/377 rows, and a
follow-up scan confirms 0 malformed emails / 0 non-`http(s)` www / 0
non-`{CC}{alnum}` nip_vat values remain in `master.csv`.

### Resolved (same day, follow-up) — RO/BG cross-catalog duplicate merge

Researched both pairs via public company registries before deciding — this
wasn't a coin flip:

- **RO**: `RO-A-002` and `RO-B-001` share identical VAT (`RO11389273`),
  registration number (`J40/12117/1998`), address, phone, and email domain.
  Cross-checked against Romanian ONRC-linked registries (firme-on-line.ro,
  listafirme.ro) — confirmed as one legal entity, TOBACCO TRADING
  INTERNATIONAL RO SRL (a Poschl Tobacco distributor). **Kept `RO-A-002`**
  (higher-priority A1 tier, richer data: `marki_nabijarki`, `wolumen`,
  LinkedIn). Folded `RO-B-001`'s unique context (Poschl group affiliation,
  alternate decydent Ram Addanki/CEO) into `RO-A-002.notatki`. Deleted
  `RO-B-001`.
- **BG**: `BG-A-001` and `BG-B-002` share the same EIK (`130768462`) but
  had *conflicting* contact details (different address/phone/email/website)
  — not just a formatting difference. Verified via ESTA's official member
  directory (esta.be/members/tti-bulgaria) and a Bulgarian registry
  aggregator (company.bg): `ttibulgaria.com` / `ul. Angelov vrah 22, Sofia`
  / `+359 2 955 74 03` (matching `BG-B-002`) is the current, confirmed
  contact set; `BG-A-001`'s `tti.bg` / different address / different phone
  matched no public source found — stale. **Kept `BG-A-001`** (A1 tier,
  has `marki_nabijarki`/`wolumen`), **upgraded its contact fields** to the
  verified set, added the newly-confirmed `rok_zalozenia: 2001` (ESTA), and
  folded in `BG-B-002`'s decydent (Tenko Bankov, Managing Director) and the
  Poschl-group affiliation note. Deleted `BG-B-002`.

Both merges recorded a full before/after audit trail in the surviving row's
`notatki` (old contact values quoted verbatim) so the correction is
traceable. Verified no other row/file referenced the deleted IDs before
removing them. `master.csv` now regenerates to **375 rows** (377 − 2);
full pytest suite (346 tests) still green; 0 duplicate `nip_vat`, 0
duplicate `id_unikalne` remain.

**Root cause:** `tools/fix_master_data_integrity.py` miał 7 miejsc z `row["notatki"] = (current + f" | {add}").strip(" |")` — append bez substring check. Po 5-6 odpaleniach (Pass 1-4) każdy rule appendował kolejne kopie.

2. **Tool idempotency patch** (`tools/fix_master_data_integrity.py`):
   - nowy helper `append_notatki_unique(row, addition)` — sprawdza substring
   - wszystkie 7 miejsc append zpatchowane (wolumen detail, alt email, lokale
     list, wolumen detail per-row, cf detail, flagi→canonical+notatki, shareholder data)
   - dry-run po patch: 0 rows changed (vs 14 przed)

3. **Re-init verify-data** (bo zawartość się zmieniła po dedup):
   - 11652 rows rehashed
   - dry-run: "No changes detected" (0 drift)

### Lessons learned (ważne!)

1. **FABRYKAT DETECTION**: Gemini potrafi wygenerować KRS-y które WSKAZUJĄ NA INNĄ FIRMĘ. KRS 0000123456 ≠ placeholder — to prawdziwy KRS firmy RODENSTOCK POLSKA. verify_run + verify_api NIE wykrywają tego — patrzą tylko na format. **Lekcja: po każdym LLM-uzupełnieniu trzeba ręcznie sprawdzić czy NIP/KRS pasuje do nazwy firmy. Weryfikacja musi obejmować name match, nie tylko checksum.**

2. **KRS API jako ground truth**: `curl https://api-krs.ms.gov.pl/api/krs/OdpisAktualny/0000123456` zwraca faktyczną firmę (RODENSTOCK). Dlatego zawsze trzeba czytać `odpis.dane.dzial1.danePodmiotu.nazwa` i porównać z CSV.

3. **NIP checksum (mod 11) szybki filtr**: 3 z 12 podejrzanych NIP-ów od razu odpadły (027/028/029 Liquider/VapeFully/E-Cigler) bo suma kontrolna się nie zgadzała. Warto sprawdzać PRZED web search.

4. **KRS API HTTP 204 ≠ brak firmy**: Stare/słabo zindeksowane wpisy (np. AMPEX 0000010733) zwracają HTTP 204. Fallback: web search potwierdza 2+ źródłami → DO-WERYFIKACJI z notatką "API 204, web confirmed".

5. **BR Sp.j. nie ma w KRS/CEIDG**: CASISS i AMPEX to sp.j. zarejestrowane w RGOP (stary system przed 2018) — nie ma publicznego KRS ani CEIDG. Trzeba szukać po REGON-ie wspólników lub przez RGOP. Aktualnie te 2 firmy zostają DO-WERYFIKACJI.

6. **ORION = PRODUCENT nie dystrybutor**: PKD 12.00.Z Produkcja wyrobów tytoniowych + koncesja 1.8 mld szt/rok. W katalogu A był błędnie jako A4 (multi-brand z PM/Hawk). Powinien być B8 (pełna hurtownia tytoniowa / producent). Top cross-sell candidate.

- Dla CASISS/AMPEX spróbować REGON lookup po NIP-ach wspólników
- Zaktualizować PL.md z nowymi wpisami

- Cron co 45 min wykrył delta=1 + 6 katalogów zmienionych (CZ/PL/RO/SK/LV)
- Pierwszy przebieg verify_run.py znalazł:
  - 1 zmieniony wpis w PL-B, 3 w LV-B, 2 w SI-B, 1 w BG-B
  - Master regen: 565 wierszy z 26 plików, 115 SKIPPED (schema drift)
- Diagnoza: pre-clean backupy (`catalog-A-PL-pre-clean-20260811_023054.csv`)
  w katalogu Polska/ były łapane przez glob `*/catalog-*.csv` i dokładały
  ~150 duplikatów do master.csv. Drugi problem: PL dostał nową kolumnę
  `_krs` (39 kol), reszta krajów ma 38 → 115 wierszy odrzuconych bo
  `col_count=38≠39`.

### Naprawy w tools/verify_run.py
1. **Glob filter (main + regenerate_master)**: regex
   `^catalog-[AB]-[A-Z]{2}\\.csv$` wyklucza derivative files
   (pre-clean, apollo cache, itp.) z katalogu per-kraj.
2. **Schema-aware union header**: master regen teraz buduje union
   wszystkich kolumn (39 = 38 + `_krs`) i pad-uje brakujące pola
   pustym stringiem przy zapisie. Brak utraty wierszy.
3. **Prune + atomic write** (już były w working tree z poprzedniej sesji,
   teraz działają z powyższymi).

### Wynik po fix
- Master regen: **383 wiersze z 24 plików** (zero skipped)
- Rozkład: PL=268, pozostałe 11 krajów po 10-11
- Schema: 39 kolumn (union), `_krs` obecny wszędzie (pusty dla non-PL)

## 2026-08-18 12:28 — Notatki Cleanup (Marceli request)

### Akcja
Czyszczenie kolumny `notatki` w `master.csv` + wszystkich 24 plikach catalog-A/B per kraj.

**Cel:** Zostawić w `notatki` TYLKO informacje których nie ma w innych kolumnach.
Usunąć duplikaty (NIP/KRS/REGON/miasto/region) i noise (structured metadata z intake).

### Co zostało usunięte (regex/strip):
- `orig_uzasadnienie: ...` (intake reasoning)
- `orig_uwagi: ...` (intake notes — jeśli puste, cały wpis w notatki też pusty)
- `Status źródłowy: ...` (już w `flagi`)
- `orig_next: ...` (action items — nie dla CSV)
- `user_orig_priorytet=...`, `user_orig_score=...`, `user_orig_segment=...` (intake scoring)
- `renamed: ...` (pipeline internal note)
- `l1: ...`, `tier-fix: ...` (pipeline internal)
- Same emoji-only flags (`✅🐋`, `🐋🔍`) — duplicate `flagi`
- PL NIP/KRS/REGON duplikaty (country-aware: only PL)
- Region code w nawiasach `(LUBELSKIE)`, `(HARJU MAAKOND)` itd.
- Miasto duplikaty (`siedziba [CITY]`, `magazyn w [CITY]`) gdy `miasto` już wypełnione
- Telefon duplikaty
- PL: "KRS API:" label po usunięciu wartości

### Migracje (fill empty target columns):
- `decydent` ← "Dział eksportu: [Name]" (gdy puste)
- `miasto` ← "siedziba [CITY]" / "magazyn w [CITY]" (gdy puste)
- `rok_zalozenia` ← "Rejestracja YYYY" / "aktywna od YYYY" (gdy puste)
- `marki_nabijarki` ← canonical brands (PowerMatic, Hawk, etc.) w tekście (gdy puste)
- `wolumen` ← "Sieć X+ sklepów" (X≥20→średni, X≥100→duży, gdy puste)

### Wyniki
- Plików przetworzonych: 24/24 catalog + master.csv (recompilowany)
- Wierszy zmienionych: 102 (w master.csv po recompile: 393 rows, 67 empty `notatki` vs 1 before)
- Migracji wykonanych: 3 (2 × `rok_zalozenia` + 1 × `marki_nabijarki` w RO-A-004)
- Notatki size reduction: 24,856 → 7,060 chars in catalog-B-PL.csv (-71.6%)
- FROZEN: 374/393 (95.2%) — unchanged
- DO-WERYFIKACJI: 19/393 (4.8%) — unchanged
- Verify-data: passed (no schema issues, hashes match new state)

### Backup
Pre-cleanup snapshot: `data/.pre-clean-notatki/20260818T122754/`
Zawiera master.csv + wszystkie 24 catalog-*.csv przed zmianą.
Rollback: `cp -r data/.pre-clean-notatki/20260818T122754/* data/`

### Narzędzie
`tools/clean_notatki.py` — dry-run + apply mode, country-aware.
- `--apply` writes changes
- `--file X` for testing single file
- `--limit N` to show only N sample changes
- Idempotent: re-running after changes is no-op

## 2026-08-22 15:40:48 UTC

### Repair: rok_zalozenia/related_to column misalignment (regression from 2026-08-21)

**Bug:** `tools/fix_master_data_integrity.py` ran 2026-08-21 and inverted the
columns for 55 rows: year values landed in `related_to`, `rok_zalozenia` was
emptied. The pre-fix snapshot at `data/master.csv.pre-fix-20260821.bak`
(0 misplaced rows) was the canonical good state. `tools/sync_verifier.py`
does not catch semantic misplacement (a year string equals itself in any
column), so the bug survived verification.

**Fix:** For each of 55 affected rows: `rok_zalozenia ← related_to`, then
`related_to ← "brak"`. Idempotent. Applied to `data/master.csv` and all
`data/*/catalog-*.csv` (sync_verifier confirms they were equally affected).

**Verification:**
- Post-fix: 0 rows with year in `related_to` (was 55)
- Post-fix: `filled rok_zalozenia` = 134 (matches pre-fix aggregate)
- Cross-check: all 55 affected `id_unikalne` values had identical year in
  `current.related_to` vs `pre-fix-20260821.bak.rok_zalozenia` (55/55 match)

**Dashboard sync:** `frontend-2/public/sample.csv` overwritten from corrected
master.csv (was 394 rows, now 417 rows; the 23 newer rows were already
absent from the dashboard bundle).

**Files changed:** data/master.csv, frontend-2/public/sample.csv, and 26
per-country catalog-*.csv (24 with affected rows + 2 with 0 — both paths
written atomically so timestamps move consistently).

**Sync re-check:** TODO — re-run `python3 tools/sync_verifier.py` post-write
to confirm master ↔ catalog re-sync after the repair.
